title: Implement enrichment coordinator in alcanzai-understanding
description:
No salvage reference — new code against the contracts.

The coordinator is the function that runs all applicable enrichers on a RawDocument and merges the results into a fully-enriched RawDocument ready for Library ingest (ADR-011).

Implement run_enrichment_pipeline(raw_document: RawDocument, enrichers: list[Enricher]) -> RawDocument in alcanzai_understanding.

Logic:
1. Sort enrichers by priority (ascending).
2. For each enricher where enricher.applies_to(raw_document.content_type): call enricher.enrich(raw_document).
3. If any EnrichmentResult.error is set: raise EnrichmentError (fail the job; do not ingest partial data — ADR-011).
4. Merge results into a new RawDocument: blocks from grobid_sections + citation context sentences attached to relevant blocks; abstract_text from grobid_abstract if richer than Atom abstract.
5. Return the fully-enriched RawDocument<Validated>.

Note: CitationEnricher needs GROBID block output to find context sentences. The coordinator passes the running enriched state (after applying GROBID result) to subsequent enrichers — so CitationEnricher.enrich() receives the GROBID-block-populated document, not the bare original.

Acceptance:
- Unit test: given mock GROBID result + mock citation result, coordinator returns RawDocument with blocks populated and citations attached.
- GROBID failure unit test: coordinator raises EnrichmentError, not a partial RawDocument.
